cues: Welcome to Class 12 Physics, Unit 10: the Nature and Propagation of Light.
In this unit we replace the ray by the wavefront, meet Huygens' principle, and use it to prove the laws of reflection and refraction from scratch.
Interference, diffraction and polarization in the next three units all stand on this geometry.
